title: Influence of C3′- and C4′-substitutions on fluorescence, crystal packing, and physicochemical properties of flavonol
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36300-36318
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05790F, Paper

Oleksii O. Demidov, Ludmila V. Chepeleva, Svitlana V. Shishkina, Eugene S. Gladkov, Alexander Kyrychenko, Rostyslav P. Linnik, Alexander D. Roshal
Fine-tuning the ESIPT fluorescence, crystal packing, and physicochemical properties of a series of flavonols was achieved by introducing hydroxy, methoxy and benzyloxy groups at the C3′ and C4′ positions of the 2-phenyl side ring.
